contribution.position: My position is unchanged: reliability evidence is still incomplete in one area. The tests (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) and the peak-load p99 result are good, but neither covers retry-storm behavior, and retry storms caused both sev2 incidents last quarter. The ops turn cites artifact:rollback-rehearsal-q3 as proof of a clean rollback rehearsal. That id is not in the available artifact list, and the runbook says no rollback rehearsal has been run for the rebuild job. Until that rehearsal record can be produced, I treat the recovery path as untested. Two items would settle this: a retry-storm or failure-injection result for the rebuild job, and either the rehearsal record or one rehearsed rollback with a timing measurement. I am not weighing cost or schedule.
